sources.title: avinashbanote/aws-ai-documentation-video-generator - GitHub
sources.snippet: An AI-powered application that automatically converts AWS documentation stored in Amazon S3 into professional educational videos. The application downloads documents from AWS S3, generates a narration script, converts it into speech, creates presentation slides, and produces a synchronized MP4 video.
